title: Octavia E. Butler Landing Site
description: Touchdown point on the basaltic volcanic floor of Jezero Crater following sky-crane descent.
missionSignificance: Historical landing site named in honor of groundbreaking science-fiction author Octavia E. Butler.

title: Wright Brothers Field Airfield
description: Designated flat 10x10-meter runway where Ingenuity was deployed and completed its first historic flights.
missionSignificance: First powered atmospheric aviation on another celestial world.

title: South Séítah Geologic Unit
description: Rugged terrain dominated by layered olivine-rich cumulate rocks of ancient volcanic origin.
missionSignificance: Core sample drilling proving that Jezero’s lowest rocks are volcanic rather than sedimentary.

title: Kodiak Butte Promontory
description: Observation waypoint surveying the eroded river delta scarp with telephoto super-resolution spectroscopy.
missionSignificance: Conclusive stratigraphy verifying ancient delta formation into a lake with varying water depth.

title: Three Forks Sample Depot
description: Flat staging area where 10 hermetically sealed titanium sample tubes were dropped onto the surface.
missionSignificance: First backup sample depot for the Mars Sample Return mission.

title: Upper Delta Front Ascent
description: Traverse up the winding channels of the delta front to reach the ancient crater rim and carbonate margin units.
missionSignificance: Climbing beyond the lake level to investigate ancient hydrothermal minerals.

title: Bradbury Landing
description: Landed via sky-crane inside northern Gale Crater on an ancient alluvial fan of smoothed river pebbles.
missionSignificance: Named in honor of author Ray Bradbury; verified immediate presence of ancient flowing water streams.

title: Yellowknife Bay Lacustrine Basin
description: Shallow depression where Curiosity drilled into fine-grained mudstone (target John Klein).
missionSignificance: Discovered that ancient Mars was habitable with fresh water, carbon, nitrogen, sulfur, and phosphorus.

title: Dingo Gap Dune Pass
description: Carefully planned drive over a 1-meter active windblown sand dune connecting two rocky valleys.
missionSignificance: Strategic test of rover mobility over loose dunes to preserve aluminum wheel longevity.

title: Pahrump Hills & Buckskin Site
description: First foothill outcrops of Mount Sharp composed of fine-laminated clay-rich mudstones.
missionSignificance: Confirmation of billions of years of persistent lacustrine sedimentary deposition.

title: Vera Rubin Ridge Iron Ridge
description: Prominent 200-meter high topographic ridge rich in gray hematite crystals resistant to wind erosion.
missionSignificance: Targeted hematite-bearing layer identified from orbit before launch.

title: Sulfate-Bearing Layer High Slopes
description: High-elevation geological transition into salty evaporite minerals representing Mars’s global drying epoch.
missionSignificance: Reading the final climatic transition from wet habitable lakes to hyper-arid desert.

title: Eagle Crater Hole-in-One
description: Airbag-cushioned landing directly inside a 22-meter impact crater exposing layered bedrock.
missionSignificance: Immediate discovery of "Martian Blueberries" (hematite concretions) proving groundwater.

title: Endurance Crater Basin Descent
description: 130-meter wide stadium-sized crater whose steep sandstone walls were traversed by Opportunity.
missionSignificance: Detailed vertical slice through ancient sulfate and dune rock beds.

title: Victoria Crater Duck Bay
description: Epic 750-meter diameter impact crater rim with scalloped cliffs of eolian sandstone.
missionSignificance: Surveyed the deepest geological layer exposed in Meridiani Planum.

title: Santa Maria Crater Pit
description: Fresh 90-meter impact crater with unweathered ejecta boulders on the rim.
missionSignificance: Detailed spectroscopy of fresh impact breccia minerals.

title: Cape York at Endeavour Rim
description: The rim of the giant 22-kilometer Endeavour Crater exposing pre-Noachian clay rocks.
missionSignificance: Discovered smectite clays formed in neutral, non-acidic potable water.

title: Perseverance Valley (Marathon Over)
description: Carved fluid-cut valley on the rim of Endeavour Crater where Opportunity concluded its 45.16-km marathon drive.
missionSignificance: Record-setting planetary distance record for any wheeled robotic vehicle in history.

title: Columbia Memorial Station
description: Airbag touchdown on the basalt-strewn plains of Gusev Crater, dedicated to the fallen astronauts of STS-107.
missionSignificance: Pioneered robotic navigation across treacherous volcanic boulder fields.

title: Bonneville Crater Rim
description: 200-meter wide crater rim surveyed in search of lakebed strata beneath basalt lava flows.
missionSignificance: Confirmed that the crater floor was buried under thick volcanic lavas.

title: Husband Hill Mountain Summit
description: Ascended 107 meters up the rocky scree of Husband Hill, conquering the highest planetary summit.
missionSignificance: First mountain climbed on another planet, discovering ancient hydrothermal alteration on slopes.

title: Home Plate Hydrothermal Plateau
description: Layered plateau of volcanic ash and pyroclastic deposits formed by ancient hot spring geysers.
missionSignificance: Serendipitous discovery of 91% pure hydrothermal silica churned up by Spirit’s locked front wheel.

title: Troy Sand Trap (Final Resting Site)
description: Soft sulfate sand pocket where Spirit became immobilized in 2009, continuing as a stationary science platform.
missionSignificance: Transformed into a static geophysical station studying Martian core wobble before final winter sunset.
